description: Free. Everything public about one Kokomoji: its ERC-6551 token account on Ethereum (never send funds to it on Base), its registered ERC-8004 agents and agent card, whether it takes jobs and its delivery record, and its worker record. Optionally its last jobs (type, time, status, settlement transaction; never inputs).
name: kokomoji_lookup
title: Look up a Kokomoji
